matrix_note: Plano 0.4.29 serves /v1/chat/completions and /v1/messages, and routes upstream through provider_interface, whose enum covers openai, claude and gemini but has no cohere or bedrock member (config/plano_config_schema.yaml). Its /v1/responses ingress is declared undeclared here rather than probed: the route exists in the crate but this harness has not established that a Responses request survives the model_providers hop, and a cell claimed on a route we have not shown to work would publish a red the project has not earned.
